jobs.title: CRA II/ SCRA
jobs.description: Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. We are passionate about cultivating our culture and are proud to share extremely high CRA retention rates compared to industry averages. Our CRAs work with a manageable study portfolio, allowing them to build deep protocol and site knowledge rather than spreading their focus across too many studies. With reasonable travel expectations, accessible line management and a smaller CRO environment, experienced CRAs have the autonomy to make decisions, influence how studies are delivered and see the impact of their work. Precision for Medicine is recruiting a Clinical Research Associate II / Senior Clinical Research Associate to join our full-service team in Poland . ** This position is fully home based ** About you: You are an experienced independent monitor who takes ownership of your sites and does not wait to be told what needs attention. You understand what really matters for patient safety, data integrity and study delivery, and can distinguish critical risks from administrative noise. You build credible relationships with investigators and site teams while remaining confident in addressing difficult or sensitive issues. You identify emerging risks early, escalate appropriately and come with solutions, not just problems. You are organized and well prepared, able to manage competing priorities across your sites without compromising quality. You communicate clearly with CTMs and study teams and can confidently represent the site perspective in project discussions. You take responsibility for the quality and outcomes of your work. How we will keep you busy and support your growth: You will independently manage and monitor investigative sites, taking ownership of site performance, quality and risk identification from site initiation through close-out. jobs.title: Teleconsult Doctor | Hotline
jobs.description: This role is open to doctors who can take shifts from the priority schedules below (minimum 8 hours/week) and interested in handling real-time, inbound patient calls through active hotline queues. Priority days/shifts: Mon-Fri 10AM-2PM Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri 4PM-8PM Wed & Thu, 3PM-7PM MedGrocer's digitally-enabled medicine programs, telehealth services, and corporate clinic medical staff work with hundreds of employers and pharma companies to improve the physical and mental health of over one million Filipinos every year. The Teleconsult Doctor is a key member of our medical team, responsible for delivering high-quality, remote medical care to patients across the Philippines. This role involves treating a wide range of patient cases, from acute conditions to chronic diseases, and providing wellness advice. As a Teleconsult Doctor, you will leverage our digital platform to make healthcare more accessible, efficient, and integrated, ensuring a seamless experience for every patient. Work Location: Remote (Work-from-Home) Onsite Training: 2 to 3 days remote or on-site in Makati Shift Commitment: Minimum of 8 hours/week Shift Length: Minimum of 4 hours/shift Compensation: ₱275/hour + ₱175 incentive per additional completed consult within the same hour (starting from the 2nd consult) Key Responsibilities Conduct comprehensive teleconsultations for non-emergency health concerns received through the hotline. Manage and monitor patients with chronic diseases, developing and adjust care plans through remote consultations. Assess patients' conditions and effectively redirect them to appropriate primary care networks or specialists when in-person evaluation is necessary. Issue e-prescriptions, laboratory requests, and other necessary medical documents through the platform. Maintain accurate, comprehensive, and timely patient records within our Electronic Medical Records (EMR) system. Fresh graduates are highly encouraged to apply! jobs.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ The Risk & Internal Control role ⭐️ Alan's Corporate team brings together Risk, Internal Control, Legal, Compliance, Corporate Governance and Security around a shared mission: building the infrastructure that lets Alan operate at scale, safely and responsibly. We are looking for a high-potential risk and internal control professional who can identify and manage risks, define and own control activities end-to-end, and grow into ownership of more complex control scopes over time. This is not a traditional, box-checking control role. We build solutions and act as genuine business partners on risks. jobs.title: Field Phlebotomy Supervisor - Northern California
jobs.description: Getlabs is the leading platform for at-home diagnostics. Healthcare organizations use Getlabs to send mobile phlebotomists to patients’ homes and collect labs, vitals, and advanced diagnostics. By leveraging Getlabs, partners can improve patient adherence and close gaps in care with same-day, nationwide availability. Our team has raised $50M from strategic investors including the two largest diagnostic laboratories in the United States, Labcorp and Quest. Getlabs’ mission is to save lives by expanding access to diagnostics for everyone. About the role: We are currently seeking a full-time Field Phlebotomy Supervisor interested in joining a high-growth stage startup. The mandate of the Field Phlebotomy Supervisor is simple but challenging: assist our Operations Manager with the day-to-day operations throughout the market and ensure our patients have the best experience possible. The Field Phlebotomy Supervisor oversees the quality of territories patient operations. You will be responsible for ensuring that every Getlabs experience meets and exceeds the patient's expectations. You will also help train and ensure quality for our team of hourly phlebotomists. Above all, we are seeking candidates who are self-starters and are resourceful, organized, detail-oriented, communicative, and friendly. This position is currently limited to candidates residing within a one-hour commute of the San Francisco Bay Area. At Getlabs, you will: Supervise a team of mobile phlebotomists in one or more geographical markets Assess work performance and perform appointment reviews for compliance, quality, and safety on a regular basis; accurately report all findings Administer disciplinary action as appropriate Interview and hire new mobile phlebotomists Effectively and efficiently onboard new hires Complete new hire and annual competency assessments for team Ensure accurate order and patient appointment record-keeping Administer performance reviewsHandle employee concerns and grievances Revi

jobs.title: Roving Clinic Nurse
jobs.description: About the role Remedy Skintech, Inc. is seeking an experienced Roving Clinic Nurse to join our dynamic team in Metro Manila. As a Roving Clinic Nurse, you will play a crucial role in providing high-quality nursing care and support to our patients in an aesthetic clinic setting. What you'll be doing Deliver high-quality laser procedures to our patients Assist on doctors' procedures In charge of post-op procedures like equipment maintenance patients' post-treatment protocols Undergo training for all Remedy treatments Collaborating with the team to coordinate patient care and facilitate a smooth patient experience Providing patient education and promoting healthy behaviours to support positive health outcomes Maintaining a clean, safe, and well-organised clinical environment What we offer At Remedy Skintech, Inc., we value our employees and strive to create a supportive, collaborative work environment. As a Roving Clinic Nurse, you can expect competitive salary, and opportunities for professional development and career advancement. About us Remedy Skintech, Inc. is a leading provider of advanced dermatological services and skincare products in the Philippines. Our mission is to empower individuals to achieve their healthiest, most radiant skin through innovative treatments and personalized care. With a team of experienced medical professionals and a state-of-the-art facility, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional patient outcomes and an unparalleled customer experience. If you're passionate about nursing and committed to making a difference in the lives of our patients, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
